import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    st = data[1]
    c = st
    a1 = 0
    a2 = 0
    i = 0
    cur = 0
    inside = False
    group_start = 0
    while i < n:
        if not inside:
            if c[i] == '(':
                if cur > a1:
                    a1 = cur
                cur = 0
                inside = True
                group_start = i + 1
                i += 1
            else:
                cur += 1
                i += 1
        else:
            while i < n and c[i] != ')':
                i += 1
            if i > group_start:
                a2 += 1
            if i < n:
                i += 1
            inside = False
    if cur > a1:
        a1 = cur
    print(a1, a2)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
